description: This Perl script generates configuration code for target hardware profiles and subtargets in an embedded Linux build system. It processes target metadata, features, dependencies, and profiles to produce configuration and makefile snippets for build customization.

methods.name: target_config_features
methods.description: Generates a string of configuration options based on input feature names, mapping each feature to its corresponding build system configuration syntax.

methods.name: target_name
methods.description: Returns a composite name of a target, combining its parent name if available.

methods.name: kver
methods.description: Converts version strings by replacing dots with underscores and normalizing to a specific format for kernel version identification.

methods.name: print_target
methods.description: Outputs configuration snippets for a specific target, including features, dependencies, and version info, formatted for inclusion in build scripts.

methods.name: merge_package_lists
methods.description: Combines two lists of package names, removing duplicates and handling marked packages with prefixes.

methods.name: gen_target_config
methods.description: Main function to generate the overall target configuration snippets, including hierarchy, profiles, device options, and associated metadata.

methods.name: gen_profile_mk
methods.description: Generates profile-specific makefile entries for a given target, including profile names, supported devices, and package lists.

methods.name: parse_command
methods.description: Dispatches command-line arguments to generate target configuration or profile metadata based on specified commands.
